notes: This is it that: This realizes הוּא and is it that realizes the written אֲשֶׁר under rule 46's first rider, with the verbless clause's copula joining the predicate under rule 20; the competing identifying-formula reading is named in the unit's note.
in them that come nigh me divides between the anarthrous substantival adjective (rule 46, headed on nigh) and its suffix (rule 18).

held his peace is treated as one light-verb rendering of דָּמַם headed on peace; the possessive is required by the English formula rather than supplied as an object, so rule 44's added-object clause does not reach it.
